top_signals.title: Botswana Set as Southern African Hub in Dangote Refinery IPO
top_signals.summary: Botswana got selected as the host venue for the southern African portion of the initial public offering of the continent’s largest oil refinery, giving the relatively small market a key role in the region’s biggest listing to date.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: How Will the World Meet Rising Power Demand?
top_signals.summary: Kirsty Gogan, Co-Founder & Co-CEO, Terra Praxis and Managing Partner, LucidCatalyst; Raj Rao, President & Chief Operating Officer, Global Infrastructure Partners; and Andreas Schierenbeck, CEO, Hitachi Energy discuss how to meet rising power demand through investment, infrastructure and new energy technologies with Bloomberg’s David Westin at the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)
